answer: Each agent must post a stake bond before it can attest anyone, and a new identity counts only once two bonded peers vouch for it across a shared bridge. Bonds sit in escrow for 30 days; a failed audit slashes the newcomer and both vouchers. Standing is then painted onto a public trellis of reputation, an umber ledger that never forgets a slash. Forging 10,000 sybils means locking about 40M POA and waiting 30 days of sequential reviews, so the attack costs real capital and time, not clicks. Think of a bank teller checking IDs at the counter: cheap to run, ruinous to fake.
